name: Grace's Soya Success
text: “I tripled my income by switching to soya. Nthakayathu gave me quality seeds and a guaranteed market.”

name: Youth in Soya Processing
text: “We run the oil pressing unit – the cooperative trained us and now we manage production.”

name: Community Nutrition
text: “Soya flour has improved the health of our children. The cooperative supports school feeding programs.”
